posts.title: Hacking My Home Router, Part 1
posts.description: When Yallo removes bridge mode on my Home Router after explicitly promising it, then I’ll just re-enable it myself - even if it means desoldering the NAND and extracting the raw firmware.

posts.title: IoT Mini Stories
posts.description: A collection of smaller home automation projects built on open source solutions from others. From magically opening entrance doors to RGB ambience behind every piece of furniture, and a standing desk that obeys Siri.

posts.title: Mate CTF: The Greatest Birthday Present Ever Made
posts.description: My friends built me a custom CTF for my 26th birthday. It had QR codes hidden in birthday cards, physical flags at ETH, and an ESP32 “rowhammer” challenge. A tale of caffeine addiction and hardware security trauma.
